subject: warning by the output for latent change score with lavvan for two time points

messages.subject: warning by the output for latent change score with lavvan for two time points
parts:
Hi, i try to computate the latent change score model with lavaan for two time points based on  Developmental cognitive neuroscience using latent change score models_ A tutorial and applications (https://doi.org/10.1016/j.dcn.2017.11.007)

And denn i got this output.
That showed "NA" by total RMSEA and robust RMSEA 
I think, i wrote right the syntax and the function.
I don't know, what is the problem hier... :/

#Fit the Univariate Latent Change Score model to simulated data
LCS_open<-'

e2hxo ~ 1*e1hxo          # Fixed regression of e2hxo on e1hxo
de1hxo =~ 1*e2hxo      # Fixed regression of dCOG1 on COG_T2
e2hxo ~ 0*1                   # This line constrains the intercept of COG_T2 to 0
e2hxo ~~ 0*e2hxo       # This fixes the variance of the COG_T2 to 0

de1hxo ~ 1                     # This estimates the intercept of the change scores
e1hxo ~  1                       # This estimates the intercept of COG_T1
de1hxo ~~  de1hxo       # This estimates the variance of the change scores
e1hxo ~~   e1hxo.          # This estimates the variance of COG_T1
de1hxo~e1hxo               # This estimates the self-feedback parameter

'

fitLCS_open <- lavaan(LCS_open, data=cl_GTEWS, estimator='mlr',fixed.x=FALSE, missing='fiml')
summary(fitLCS_open, fit.measures=TRUE, standardized=TRUE, rsquare=TRUE)
